newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks climb in morning, led by high techs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks climb in morning, led by high techs.

text.p: Tokyo stocks climbed early on Friday morning as market participants continued to seek high-technology issues, brokers said.
They said, however, that as it is Friday and position squaring was expected, the market was keen to see how much of the gains will be maintained throughout the day.
As of 0020 GMT, the Nikkei average was up 50.20 points or 0.25 percent at 19,804.98. September futures were flat at 19,780.
